newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Top end Auckland house prices rebound - Bayleys.
newsitem.headline: Top end Auckland house prices rebound - Bayleys.

text.p: Top end Auckland residential property sales activity bounced back in the quarter ended in January, Bayleys Real Estate said in a research bulletin published on Monday..

The number of sales above $350,000 increased 75 percent to 961. However, the increase was off a very low base from the previous quarter when the top end became inactive in the face of reduced confidence, higher interest rates and slowing economic growth.
According to Real Estate Institute of New Zealand figures, sales in the overall Auckland residential market rose 12 percent, from 6666 to 7444 in the most recent quarter.
The number of sales above $700,000 almost doubled. In the range from $700,000 to just under $1 million they reached 120, from 64, and above $1 million they were up at 40 from 22.
The median price for properties above $350,000 hit a record level since the Bayleys Residential Index began, rising 1.7 percent to $459,000.

In the apartments sector, Bayleys said the trend to smaller apartments continued. Central Auckland should have 986 new units in the next two years, and 38 percent of these would be studios, 43 percent one bedroom, 17 percent two bedrooms and just 2 percent three bedrooms or larger.
Bayleys said the trend was driven by maintaining economic viability of new complexes as building and land costs rose. Also, smaller units returned more per square metre than larger ones.
